contextExceptions.named lifecycle lookups: Optional previous run-owned clients/sessions must be closed before replacing the inherited property; retain nullable named lookup.
contextExceptions.flow_grain: Validated graph exports captured before coroutine work; parameters selected dynamically by name.
contextExceptions.HTML/SVG: Retain color swatch layouts, interactive boards, editable buffer DOM views, presentation HTML DSL and SVG parser input. Plain textual readouts use Markdown.

reviewCategories.readability and idiom review: Formatting/imports, literal/comment preservation, collection literals, context and output idioms; retained algorithms and native/resource ownership. Curated helper references and targeted real behavior/captures are recorded separately.
reviewCategories.language review: Respect actual execution language; source-language adjudications in language-review.json. No Kotlin formatter on foreign language bodies.
reviewCategories.preserved provenance: Recorded speculative study; byte identity checked, no formatting or rewriting.
reviewCategories.shader review: Reviewed layout, units, coordinate spaces and comments; actual GLSL formatter. Complete stages compile before/after; partial fragments stay in their teaching context.
reviewCategories.signature fragment: Deliberately abbreviated signature, not an executable box; annotation API is the lesson.
